workflow_metadata.name: Setup Workflow
workflow_metadata.description: Initialize system, configure paths, set up environment and foundational documents
workflow_metadata.created_from: decision_flow.json v2.5.0 - extracted Arch-00, Arch-01, and initialization logic
workflow_metadata.purpose: Establish all prerequisites for architecture and development workflows

path_configuration.description: Critical path setup - all paths must be absolute for tool invocations

reflow_root.verification: Check for presence of core directories

system_root.description: Where the system being developed is located (e.g., /home/user/projects/my_system)

path_best_practices: Store reflow tools in one location (e.g., ~/dev/reflow/)
Store each system in its own location (e.g., ~/projects/system_name/)
Use absolute paths when invoking tools to avoid confusion
Within system files, always use relative paths for portability
Never assume systems are in reflow/systems/ directory

new_system.description: Starting a brand new system or concept
new_system.trigger: User wants to create a new system from scratch

new_concept_or_system.description: New concept that may become one or more systems
new_concept_or_system.trigger: User has a new idea to develop

system_of_systems.trigger: User wants to create a system-of-systems architecture

context_management.description: Prevent context drift and token exhaustion during workflow execution

rag_enhanced_mode.description: RECOMMENDED - Use RAG for automatic context injection and degradation detection
rag_enhanced_mode.benefits: Automatic retrieval, degradation detection, systematic rule enforcement
rag_enhanced_mode.usage: Use rag_agent_wrapper.py to wrap queries: python3 {reflow_root}/tools/rag_agent_wrapper.py {system_root} wrap --query 'your query' --strategy on_step_start
rag_enhanced_mode.fallback: If RAG not set up, use manual context management below

operations_counter.rule: Increment after each real operation (file creation, tool execution, artifact generation)
operations_counter.rag_alternative: RAG provides automatic periodic refresh every 4 operations or 12 minutes

degradation_signals_watch_for: Asking about system name (it's in working_memory.json)

degradation_detection_tools.rag_automatic: If RAG enabled, use: python3 {reflow_root}/tools/rag_agent_wrapper.py {system_root} analyze --response response.txt
degradation_detection_tools.manual: If RAG not enabled, watch for degradation signals above and manually trigger refresh

refresh_sequence_summary: 2. VERIFY PWD - Confirm in correct directory
3. SAVE STATE - Update working_memory.json and step_progress_tracker.json
4. RELOAD - Read workflow file, definitions, templates (OR use RAG wrapper for automatic injection)
6. CONFIRM - State system name, workflow, step, next action
pre_operation_checklist: Read current_focus.md (OR use RAG wrapper for automatic context)
rag_tools_available: rag_agent_wrapper.py wrap - Wrap query with relevant context
rag_agent_wrapper.py analyze - Detect degradation in responses
generate_rag_embeddings.py --force-rebuild - Rebuild embeddings if workflows updated

self_improvement.description: Continuous workflow improvement through observation and metrics

during_execution.document: Log observations to context/process_log.md with timestamps

workflow_steps.name: Path Configuration
workflow_steps.description: Configure all required paths for reflow operation

actions.verification: Ensure reflow_root contains tools/, templates/, definitions/, workflows/
Confirm system directory exists or create it

actions.description: Derive and store all tool paths

actions.purpose: Store LLM agent tracking files (working_memory.json, step_progress_tracker.json, current_focus.md)
Store foundational documents and system documentation

workflow_steps.name: Foundational Documents
workflow_steps.description: Create or validate foundational system documents

actions.description: Initialize RAG-Enhanced Context Management (OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED)
actions.purpose: Set up automatic context retrieval to prevent drift and enforce workflow adherence
actions.recommended: Strongly recommended to prevent context drift and systematic workflow enforcement

setup_steps.action: Edit RAG config and set system_name
setup_steps.update: Set system_name field to match actual system name

benefits: Automatic context injection based on workflow state
Systematic enforcement of critical behavioral rules
Token-efficient context retrieval (2000-8000 tokens vs 5000-10000 manual)
Prevents LLM agents from forgetting workflow instructions

retrieval_strategies: on_step_start - Load workflow instructions for current step
on_user_query - Semantic search across all knowledge bases
periodic_refresh - Auto-refresh every 4 operations or 12 minutes
degradation_patterns: workflow_violation - Detects skipping steps or ignoring workflow
system_isolation_breach - Detects wrong directory or cross-system access
context_confusion - Detects forgetting system name or current step

usage_in_workflows.manual_mode: LLM agent manually reads working_memory.json and current_focus.md
usage_in_workflows.rag_enhanced_mode: Use rag_agent_wrapper.py to automatically inject relevant context

gates.name: Foundational Documents Complete
checks: Documents contain meaningful content (not just templates)

workflow_steps.name: System-of-Systems Decision
workflow_steps.description: Determine if this is a system-of-systems integration project
workflow_steps.question: Is this a system-of-systems integration project (multiple independent systems that need to work together)?

no.description: Single system or standard service decomposition

workflow_steps.name: System-of-Systems Decomposition (Optional)
workflow_steps.description: Decompose high-level concept into multiple independent systems
workflow_steps.when_to_use: Multi-system integration projects where systems have independent lifecycles

actions.purpose: Identify independent systems that need integration
Clarify which capabilities belong to which system
Each system gets its own directory structure

workflow_steps.note: Each identified system will go through workflows independently, then integrate

completion.description: Setup workflow complete - system is ready for architecture phase

critical_reminders: ALWAYS use absolute paths when invoking tools: python3 {reflow_root}/tools/<tool>.py {system_root}
Store all path configuration in context/working_memory.json for future reference
Verify reflow_root contains required directories before proceeding
Never assume system is located in reflow/systems/ - it can be anywhere
Use workflow_driver.py to track progress through setup steps
common_mistakes: Using relative paths for tool invocation (causes 'file not found' errors)
Skipping foundational documents (causes issues in later workflows)
Not initializing working_memory.json with path configuration
